news.title: Catholics in Latin America generally have positive views of Pope Leo
news.summary_en: In six Latin American countries surveyed, most Catholics view Pope Leo XIV favorably, though his ratings trail those Pope Francis received early in his papacy.

news.title: Most U.S. Catholics view Pope Leo favorably; many think Trump has been too critical of him
news.summary_en: About eight-in-ten U.S. Catholics view Pope Leo XIV favorably, though opinions on the tension between Leo and President Trump split sharply along party lines.

news.title: Is U.S. fertility at an all-time low? It depends how you measure it
news.summary_en: U.S. fertility rates have hit historic lows, but three common measures tell different stories about whether American families are truly shrinking.

news.title: What the data says about abortion in the U.S.
news.summary_en: Six-in-ten US adults say abortion should be legal in all or most cases. Here’s a look at data on abortion rates, providers, demographics and more.

news.title: Americans and AI 2026: Chatbots, Smart Devices and Views on Impact
news.summary_en: More Americans are using chatbots, and some are adopting AI summaries and smart speakers. But views about AI and how fast it’s advancing tilt negative – even for younger adults.
